question: What enduring quality makes the described reality dear to the yoginis?
premises: The reality is described as having splendor equal to the rising sun.
This splendor is said to be eternal.
The reality is characterized as dear to the yoginis.
inference: An eternally radiant reality, like the rising sun, is affirmed as beloved of the yoginis.
plain_english: It is eternally radiant like the rising sun and indeed dear to the yoginis.
